milestones.title: 1.02 — Safe storage and recovery
milestones.description: Researchers can back up and restore projects safely, with PHI-aware Box safeguards.

milestones.title: 1.03 — Fast human validation
milestones.description: Researchers can review uncertain transcript sections quickly and record validation status.

milestones.title: 1.04 — Portable research collaboration
milestones.description: Projects can be handed off, inspected, and re-imported without a cloud service.

milestones.title: 1.05 — Research-quality assistance
milestones.description: Vocabulary, de-identification review, multilingual validation, and cautious speaker assistance improve outcomes.

milestones.title: Ongoing — Accessibility, release trust, quality
milestones.description: The app is usable, supportable, testable, and trusted on supported desktops.

issues.title: Define the U of I Box and BHDF integration policy
issues.goal: Obtain institutional decisions required to design a compliant opt-in U of I Box backup feature.
acceptance_criteria: Written guidance confirms whether a Local Scribe Box app may access BHDFs.
An approved BHDF-identification method is documented; folder names alone are explicitly rejected.
OAuth application type, scopes, token storage, retention, collaboration, and audit expectations are documented.
Approved test process uses no PHI unless specifically authorized.
Product copy is reviewed so Local Scribe does not overstate HIPAA/IRB compliance.
issues.dependency_note: U of I HIPAA Privacy Office, Box administrators, institutional security review.

issues.title: Add per-project data sensitivity declaration
acceptance_criteria: Projects support `no_phi`, `may_contain_phi`, and `unknown_treat_as_phi` states.
New-project and first-backup flows explain selection responsibility.
PHI/unknown states prevent non-BHDF remote backup.
State is present in project metadata and backup manifests.
Existing projects migrate to conservative defaults.
issues.dependency_note: R01 for final BHDF enforcement behavior.

issues.title: Build a stable, checksummed project snapshot format
acceptance_criteria: Immutable snapshot excludes transient caches/logs by default.
Manifest contains format/app version, project ID, transcription provenance, files, sizes, and SHA-256 checksums.
Media-included and transcript-only modes are supported.
Restore verifies checksums before import.
Archive schema is versioned and migration-tested.

issues.title: Implement local backup, restore, and destructive-action safeguards
acceptance_criteria: UI supports local snapshot creation and restore.
Destructive actions and overwrite imports offer confirmation and snapshot option.
Restore never silently overwrites; it offers rename/replace/abort.
Outcomes appear in local activity history.

issues.title: Implement opt-in U of I Box backup connector
acceptance_criteria: OAuth sign-in/revocation, folder selection, upload, retry, cancellation, and post-upload verification work.
Credentials use OS credential storage, never archives/logs.
Remote work requires explicit user action and is blocked by Offline Lock.
PHI/unknown projects target only a verified BHDF according to R01.
No generic Box folder is selected automatically.
Mocked API tests cover auth failure, partial upload, destination rejection, and token revocation.

issues.title: Add privacy center, activity history, and sanitized diagnostics
acceptance_criteria: Privacy Center shows Offline Lock, backup configuration, storage location, and last remote action.
Activity history records network-affecting and recovery actions.
Diagnostics exclude media, transcript content, tokens, and user paths by default.
Users inspect diagnostics before saving.

issues.title: Add startup and storage health checks
acceptance_criteria: Checks report low storage, inaccessible data directory, corrupt/missing model data, and unsupported runtime.
Model download flows show estimated disk requirements.
Checks never transmit data.

issues.title: Create Review Mode and issue queue
acceptance_criteria: Queue supports low-confidence segments, possible artifacts, unassigned speakers, flags, and changed-since-validation segments.
Filters, counts, and completion progress are visible.
Review actions advance efficiently to the next unresolved item.
Queue state is portable with project data.

issues.title: Add playback and keyboard-first review controls
acceptance_criteria: Playback speed, pre-roll/post-roll, loop/replay, waveform cursor, and zoom are available.
Core actions have documented keyboard shortcuts.
Controls have accessible labels and focus.
Tests cover timestamp seeking and range-media behavior.

issues.title: Add validation states, sign-off, and export provenance
acceptance_criteria: State model is Draft → Transcribed → In review → Validated → Exported.
Reviewer, time, and notes are stored locally.
Reopening validation is deliberate and recorded.
Export status/provenance is included where format permits.

issues.title: Specify and version the `.lsproj` interchange format
acceptance_criteria: Public specification covers manifest, checksums, version, provenance, and migrations.
Transcript-only imports clearly identify missing media.
Integrity results are visible.
Golden archives protect backward compatibility.

issues.title: Build offline handoff, annotations, and conflict handling
acceptance_criteria: Review package supports selected transcript, optional media, instructions, and annotations.
Timestamped comments/questions persist.
Conflict import preserves both versions and guides resolution.
No real-time synchronization is added.

issues.title: Add vocabulary profiles and study presets
acceptance_criteria: Profiles support reuse, CSV/TXT import, and project assignment.
They integrate transparently with prompt/hotword settings.
Provenance records profile/settings without exporting sensitive vocabulary by default.
An uncertain-term report is available.

issues.title: Add reversible de-identification review assistance
acceptance_criteria: Configurable assistive flags cover common identifiers and custom patterns.
Replacements are explicit, reversible, and revision-tracked.
Replacement map is local and excluded from shareable exports by default.
Review report lists flagged/resolved/skipped items.
UI/docs say it is not a compliance guarantee.
issues.sequencing_note: Privacy review is required before R14 is released.

issues.title: Validate multilingual support and improve speaker workflow
acceptance_criteria: Supported languages have tested transcription, proofreading, exports, and UI behavior.
Detection/selection only claims supported coverage.
Manual speaker workflow improves before automation.
Experimental diarization is opt-in, confidence-marked, reversible, and human-confirmed.

issues.title: Accessibility release baseline
acceptance_criteria: Keyboard-only operation covers main workflows and modals.
Screen-reader labels, focus behavior, scalable text, high contrast, and non-color cues are tested.
Accessibility checks are part of PR/release review.

issues.title: End-to-end quality and regression suite
acceptance_criteria: Non-sensitive fixtures cover import → processing fixture → edit/review → export → archive/import.
Golden outputs cover SRT, VTT, DOCX, JSON, and archive manifests.
Migration/package upgrade tests cover supported desktops.
Box tests are mocked and never use PHI.

issues.title: Code-signing and distribution feasibility spike
acceptance_criteria: Windows MSIX/Microsoft Store compatibility is evaluated with local data, bundled Python, model downloads, and updates.
macOS Developer ID/notarization and possible U of I fee-waiver path are documented.
SignPath Foundation eligibility is investigated as non-guaranteed.
CI secret management and signature/notarization verification plans are documented.
Decision record compares cost, user friction, work, and supportability.
issues.sequencing_note: Proceeds continuously; begin early enough to affect the next installer release.
